position: MA in Communication, Communication Studies, or closely related field by Aug. 16, 2027

required.title: Letter of Interest
required.desc: Address teaching philosophy, professional goals, and interest in working in NMSU Communication Studies.

required.title: Curriculum Vitae
required.desc: Use a teaching-focused CV that makes teaching breadth, modalities, course development, service, and outreach easy to see.

required.title: Evidence of Teaching Effectiveness
required.desc: Include evidence from both face-to-face and online environments.

required.title: Multicultural / Diverse Ways of Learning Statement
required.desc: Explain how multicultural scholarship or diverse ways of thinking and learning have influenced your teaching.

required.title: Three Professional References
required.desc: Provide contact information for three references. Letters are requested if you are selected for an interview.

workflow.title: Review the official posting end-to-end
workflow.desc: Confirm requirements, duties, qualifications, and deadline language.

workflow.title: Choose three references
workflow.desc: Select people who can speak to teaching, student mentorship, professionalism, and disciplinary expertise.

workflow.title: Ask references for permission
workflow.desc: Send them the posting and explain that letters are requested only if you advance to interview.

workflow.title: Audit your CV against the posting
workflow.desc: Make teaching, modalities, course development, recruitment, service, and outreach easy to find.

workflow.title: Draft the Letter of Interest
workflow.desc: Center teaching philosophy, generalist teaching range, professional goals, and why NMSU Communication Studies.

workflow.title: Build a Teaching Effectiveness Portfolio
workflow.desc: Gather evaluations, peer observations, assignments, course materials, and evidence from face-to-face and online instruction.

workflow.title: Draft multicultural / diverse learning statement
workflow.desc: Use concrete examples showing how scholarship and diverse ways of learning affect your teaching choices.

workflow.title: Map yourself to the course list
workflow.desc: Identify courses you can teach immediately and courses you could credibly prepare.

workflow.title: Document online / asynchronous experience
workflow.desc: Identify 8-week asynchronous teaching, LMS design, or online curriculum experience.

workflow.title: Document service, outreach, and recruitment
workflow.desc: Translate coordination, program-building, student support, outreach, and recruitment into faculty-relevant language.

workflow.title: Proofread the full application package
workflow.desc: Check dates, titles, claims, course names, and consistent emphasis across all documents.

workflow.title: Complete the NMSU electronic application
workflow.desc: The electronic application is the official qualifying document.

workflow.title: Attach every required document
workflow.desc: Verify each attachment opens correctly and is the intended final version.

workflow.title: Submit by Jan. 3, 2027 at 11:59 PM MT
workflow.desc: Do not rely on the later Jan. 14 system closing date.

workflow.title: Save submission confirmation
workflow.desc: Keep a copy of the confirmation and the exact documents submitted.
